questions.prompt: Kodi adiresi ya IP ya mtundu wa IPv4 imakhala ndi ma bits angati onse?
questions.explanation: Adiresi ya IPv4 imapangidwa ndi ma bits 32 omwe amagawika m'magulu anayi (octets).

questions.prompt: Kodi Broadcasting Address imagwira ntchito yanji pa netiweki?
choices: Kutumiza uthenga ku zida zonse zomwe zili pa netiwekiimodzi
Kuteteza netiweki ku zigawenga za pa intaneti
questions.answer: Kutumiza uthenga ku zida zonse zomwe zili pa netiwekiimodzi
questions.explanation: Broadcast address imagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi zida kutumiza ma packet ku zida zonse zomwe zili pa subnet imodzi.

questions.prompt: Pa njira zoperekera adiresi ya IP, kodi DHCP imayimira chiyani?
questions.explanation: DHCP ndi njira yomwe imapereka ma adiresi a IP ku zida zatsopano zomwe zatsika pa netiweki mwadzidzidzi.

questions.prompt: Fotokozani kusiyana komwe kulipo pakati pa IP adiresi ya static (Static IP) ndi ya dynamic (Dynamic IP), ndipo tchulani pamene mungagwiritse ntchito iliyonse.
modelPoints: Static IP imakhala yokhazikika ndipo sisinthikaokha.
Dynamic IP imasinthasintha ndipo imaperekedwa ndi seva ya DHCP.
Static IP imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa maseva (servers) kapena zida zomwe zimafunikira kupezeka nthawi zonse.
Dynamic IP imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa makompyuta a anthu wamba kapena zida za m'nyumba ndi maofesi kuti zosamalira zikhale zosavuta.

questions.prompt: Fotokozani momwe angapo a Subnet Mask ndi IP Address amagwirira ntchito limodzi kuti adziwe ngati chipangizo chili pa netiweki imodzi (local) kapena netiweki ina (remote).
modelPoints: Kugwiritsa ntchito masamu a bitwise AND pakati pa IP Address ndi Subnet Mask.
Kuyerekeza Network ID ya gwero (source) ndi yomwe ikupita (destination).
Ngati zili zofanana, zida zimalankhulana mwachindunji (local), ngati sizofanana, zimatumizidwa kudzera pa Router (remote).
